boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 惠蓀林場（國立中興大學實驗林官方頁；7,477 公頃、海拔 450-2419m 垂直分佈、原生樟楓林與關刀溪谷）森林主體（OSM nature_reserve 節點；海拔帶不可單值化、誠實留空）；清單主題的紅葉/日出季窗查無本站可繫結的權威季節資料源，誠實不建時間窗契約；與同清單惠蓀林場高點（~1km）同林場家族叢集——高點列不重複入庫。
boosters_i18n.en: Huisun Forest Station (NCHU official experimental-forest page; 7,477 ha, 450-2,419 m vertical range, native camphor-maple forest and the Guandao creek valley). The list's maple/sunrise windows have no bindable seasonal source - honestly no time-window contract; the sibling 'Huisun high point' row (~1 km) is the same forest family and not separately admitted.
boosters_i18n.ja: 恵蓀林場（中興大学実験林公式、原生林と渓谷）。紅葉・日の出の季節窓は権威源がなく誠実に不構築。

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
